research_lane: independent external synthetic; not native Yggdrasil
question: At equal total context-1 intervention count, does greedy expected-information-gain action selection improve exact accepted causal rule identification relative to balanced and random actions?
hypothesis: The frozen greedy information-gain policy improves accepted exact familiar causal mechanisms by >=8/192 over balanced, >=5/192 over random, without a meaningful false-acceptance or predictive-accuracy penalty.

cohort.base_ids: 8..15, held out from earlier historical training base IDs 0..7

frozen_generator.context1_tape: 64 pre-generated independent noisy potential outcomes per action (never exposed except sampled actions)

trained_weights_source: LR-92AD train-only q-conditioned learned context differences, fixed from PR #1267; no new training or lookahead

policy_definition.eig: select action with maximum posterior predictive binary entropy; tie by least previous selections then action index
policy_definition.random: independent frozen seeded uniform action choice
policy_definition.stale_eig: repeat initial maximum-EIG action; sham non-adaptive
policy_definition.top2: select action disagreeing between top two posterior hypotheses; fall back to EIG

controls: Main comparison uses identical Bayesian 256-state model and frozen prior, confidence threshold and total 176 fitting and 256 validation labels across policies. The sole varying factor is the context1 intervention-selection policy.
acceptance: Posterior max >= .90 AND fit-only binomial survival p> .01; no heldout labels influence fitting or action choice
go_checks: cold restored delta is bit exact
all arms use exactly 64 context1 actions
metric_defs: Exact accepted complete 8-bit mechanism on 192 known-mode worlds, 48 unseen-mode; false acceptance, heldout accuracy over 61,440 outcomes, 5-bin ECE of MAP confidence, CPU policy time and wall time. All policies use identical environmental potential-outcome tapes, with each action sequentially revealing its own unviewed outcomes.

classification.DEVELOPMENT_GO: all eight frozen GO checks true; independent synthetic signal only
classification.DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO: one or more checks false in valid execution; preserve full negative record
classification.INVALID: source/prereg mismatch, reused scored seeds, missing data, post-result tuning, leakage, or audit failure

pre_primary_structural_tests: 9/9 PASS on nonprimary fixture seeds (no registered seeds evaluated)
